workstreams.name: NONPRODUCTION_ENDPOINT
workstreams.objective: Define and verify an isolated non-production endpoint boundary without creating it in OP-0.
workstreams.scope: planning and acceptance-contract only in OP-0
workstreams.rollback_requirement: Level 7 network-route revoke and Level 5 deployment rollback must be executable before Stage 1.

workstreams.name: WORKLOAD_CREDENTIAL
workstreams.objective: Specify a short-lived read-only non-production workload identity and revocation evidence.
workstreams.scope: planning and acceptance-contract only in OP-0
workstreams.rollback_requirement: Level 6 credential revoke drill is mandatory.

workstreams.name: TEST_ACCOUNT_ALLOWLIST
workstreams.objective: Define synthetic/test-account-only identity admission with purpose and environment binding.
workstreams.scope: planning and acceptance-contract only in OP-0
workstreams.rollback_requirement: Allowlist can be emptied immediately; traffic must fail closed.

workstreams.name: STABLE_HASH_COHORT
workstreams.objective: Define deterministic Stage 1 selection at a 1% ceiling for hashed non-production test subjects.
workstreams.scope: planning and acceptance-contract only in OP-0
implementation_location: new OP-1 selector component path to be approved
workstreams.rollback_requirement: Flag OFF and global kill switch return effective selection to zero.

workstreams.name: CANDIDATE_ADAPTER_READINESS
workstreams.objective: Resolve and prepare the actual read-only candidate source while preserving no-serving and primary authority.
workstreams.scope: planning and acceptance-contract only in OP-0
workstreams.rollback_requirement: Level 2 lane kill and Level 3 global disable must isolate candidate source failures.

workstreams.name: METRIC_INSTRUMENTATION
workstreams.objective: Close Stage 1 metric gaps while preserving the authoritative 27-metric inventory.
workstreams.scope: planning and acceptance-contract only in OP-0
workstreams.rollback_requirement: Metrics must remain available during disable/rollback and must prove selected traffic stops.

workstreams.name: DASHBOARD_AND_ALERTING
workstreams.objective: Define operational dashboards, critical alerts and warning routes for Stage 1.
workstreams.scope: planning and acceptance-contract only in OP-0
acceptance_criteria: critical alerts route to staffed destination
workstreams.rollback_requirement: Critical alerts must support manual global disable; no automatic rollout.

workstreams.name: ROLLBACK_DRILL
workstreams.objective: Plan and execute Levels 1-7 rollback drills before Stage 1.
workstreams.scope: planning and acceptance-contract only in OP-0
acceptance_criteria: credential and network revocation tested in OP-2
workstreams.rollback_requirement: Each drill must restore or preserve flag OFF and effective traffic 0.

workstreams.name: ROLE_APPROVALS
workstreams.objective: Assemble six blocking approval packages without representing pending approval as approved.
workstreams.scope: planning and acceptance-contract only in OP-0
workstreams.rollback_requirement: Any rejection or expired approval keeps traffic blocked.

workstreams.name: MANUAL_ENABLEMENT_RUNBOOK
workstreams.objective: Define the exact manual enablement, observation, abort and evidence sequence.
workstreams.scope: planning and acceptance-contract only in OP-0
workstreams.rollback_requirement: Level 1-7 steps linked; any false gate forces traffic 0.
